name: Primary Pop by Gilmar Smith
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
Primary Pop is designed to make your images burst with vibrant primary colors, adding depth and saturation to every shot. Inspired by the joy and energy that bold colors can evoke, this recipe brings a touch of happiness to your photography with its lively hues. The recipe introduces a subtle matte effect, protecting dark areas while maintaining a clean, polished look, while enhanced contrast and meticulous treatment of primary colors create a stunning visual impact, making every image stand out. With Primary Pop, your photos will exude a vivid, dynamic feel while preserving crisp highlights.
